_purpose: Divergences from the one-visual-language rule that EXIST TODAY and are owned by a specific tab. Pinning them makes the gates usable: a NEW divergence fails the build, while a known one is tracked with an owner instead of switching the gate off.
_rule: THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. Adding an entry requires the product owner's acceptance. An entry whose file no longer exists fails Pinned_exceptions_that_no_longer_occur_must_be_removed - so the list cannot rot into a permanent amnesty.
_severity: Critical = second design language or functional regression | High = visible layout/RTL/a11y regression | Medium = orphaned reference or inconsistent component | Low = comment or dead attribute

legacy-design-language.reason: 25 live cbw-* class attributes. The file is ORPHANED - zero inbound references, no view renders it - so it affects no screen. It is the last carrier of the retired CrossBusiness Blue vocabulary and the last referrer of the retired stylesheet.
legacy-design-language.clears-when: the orphaned layout is deleted in a dedicated cleanup commit

inline-design-tokens.reason: PRINT ARTIFACT, not a screen. Wrapped in '@media print' with '@page { size:A4; margin:10mm }'; the colours are printer greyscale (#000/#fff/#111/#555/#999/#d0d0d0) and the barcode uses monospace. The screen visual language does not govern ink on a physical shelf label, and Metronic tokens have no meaning there. Pinned individually rather than exempting all print views, so that a future print view must be justified too and nobody can dodge the gate by adding '@media print'.
inline-design-tokens.clears-when: n/a - accepted by design. Re-evaluate only if this becomes a screen.

stylesheet-design-tokens.reason: The retired CrossBusiness Blue design system, kept as a TEMPORARY compatibility artifact under the LEGACY banner. Its only referrer is the orphaned _LayoutWorkspace.cshtml, so it reaches no live screen.
stylesheet-design-tokens.clears-when: no file references it and it is deleted in a dedicated cleanup commit
